# AliExpress

> AliExpress is a global wholesale and retail ecommerce marketplace platform enabling direct trade between buyers and sellers.

AliExpress, owned by Alibaba Group, operates as a cross-border ecommerce platform connecting millions of buyers with suppliers worldwide. The platform specializes in wholesale purchasing, bulk orders, and direct-to-consumer retail transactions.

## Key Topics

- wholesale marketplace
- ecommerce platform
- bulk buying
- buyer account
- cross-border trade
- Alibaba Group
- product listings
- user navigation
- cookie policy
- order management

## Wholesale & Marketplace

- [AliExpress Wholesale](https://www.aliexpress.com/wholesale.html): AliExpress wholesale marketplace platform for bulk buying and direct supplier connections
